text: In November 1915, British authorities prosecuted Methuen, the publisher of D.H. Lawrence's The Rainbow, under the Obscene Publications Act of 1857 over the novel’s treatment of sexual love. After the trial, copies were seized and burnt, and the book was banned in Britain for 11 years.
meta_description: The Rainbow by D.H. Lawrence: publisher prosecuted in November 1915; copies burnt and the book banned in Britain for 11 years.
